name: Bird
description: Bird lets agents send email, SMS, and WhatsApp messages, verify domains, manage numbers, and inspect message delivery in the workspace of the signed-in account. Each user signs in to their own Bird account through the browser.

prompts.text: Why did the last password reset email to this address fail?
Check the DNS records for our sending domain and tell me what is missing.
Send a test SMS to my own number with the new template.

apps.name: Bird
apps.description: Messaging, domain, number, and delivery tools, over Bird's MCP server with browser sign-in.
